data.name: Paramanand
data.gender_notes: Paramanand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Paramanand is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Parama’ meaning supreme and ‘Anand’ meaning bliss. This name signifies the attainment of the highest state of happiness and peace. The name Paramanand carries the meaning “Supreme Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Paramanand usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the pursuit of ultimate spiritual joy and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Paramanand belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme Bliss.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Paramanand total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Paramanand was a renowned Hindu monk and philosopher, who lived during the 14th to 15th centuries. He was a prominent figure of the Bhakti movement, which emphasized the importance of devotion to God as a means to achieve spiritual enlightenment. Paramanand is best known for his works that advocate the path of love and devotion to the deity Rama.
historical_references.context: Bhakti movement, devotion to God, Rama

historical_references.reference: Paramanand was also known as Paramansham, and he was a prolific author, who wrote numerous commentaries, hymns, and philosophical treatises. Some of his most well-known works include 'Ananda Ramayana', 'Nityasukhrahasya', and 'Abhijnana Ramayana', which continue to be revered and studied by Hindus around the world.
